Top XX Nodes by Current Response Time.swql:
SELECT TOP 10 Nodes.NodeID, Caption, GroupStatus, ResponseTime, PercentLoss, IP_Address, DNS, SysName, Nodes.Status
FROM Orion.Nodes (nolock = true) Nodes
WHERE Nodes.Status NOT IN ('11', '9', '12')
ORDER BY (CASE WHEN ResponseTime<0 THEN 2147483647 ELSE ResponseTime END) DESC, PercentLoss DESC

Top XX Nodes by Percent Packet Loss.swql:
SELECT TOP 10 Nodes.NodeID, Caption, GroupStatus, PercentLoss, ResponseTime, IP_Address, DNS, SysName, Nodes.Status
FROM Orion.Nodes (nolock = true) Nodes
WHERE Nodes.Status NOT IN ('11', '9', '12')
ORDER BY PercentLoss DESC, ResponseTime DESC

Top XX Nodes by Average CPU Load.swql:
SELECT TOP 10 Nodes.NodeID, Caption, GroupStatus, CPULoad, IP_Address, DNS, SysName, Nodes.Status
FROM Orion.Nodes (nolock = true) Nodes
WHERE CPULoad >= 0 AND Nodes.Status NOT IN ('11', '9', '12')
ORDER BY CPULoad DESC

Top XX Nodes by Percent Memory Used.swql:
SELECT TOP 10 Nodes.NodeID, Caption, GroupStatus, PercentMemoryUsed, IP_Address, DNS, SysName, Nodes.Status
FROM Orion.Nodes (nolock = true) Nodes
WHERE PercentMemoryUsed > 0 AND Nodes.Status NOT IN ('11', '9', '12')
ORDER BY PercentMemoryUsed DESC

Top XX Volumes by Disk Space Used.swql:
SELECT TOP 10 Nodes.NodeID, Nodes.Caption as NodeName, Volumes.VolumeID, Volumes.Caption as Volume,
       Volumes.VolumePercentUsed, Volumes.VolumeSize, Volumes.VolumeSpaceUsed, Nodes.Status
FROM Orion.Volumes Volumes
INNER JOIN Orion.Nodes Nodes ON Volumes.NodeID = Nodes.NodeID
WHERE Volumes.VolumePercentUsed > 0 AND Nodes.Status NOT IN ('11', '9', '12')
ORDER BY Volumes.VolumePercentUsed DESC

Top XX Components by Response Time.swql: SELECT TOP 10 Application.Name AS Application, Name AS Component, ResponseTime FROM Orion.APM.Component WHERE ResponseTime IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ResponseTime DESC

Top XX Components by Statistic Data.swql: SELECT TOP 10 DisplayName, StatisticData FROM Orion.APM.Component WHERE StatisticData IS NOT NULL ORDER BY StatisticData DESC

Top XX Monitored Processes by CPU Load.swql: SELECT TOP 10 DisplayName, CPULoad, PhysicalMemoryUsed FROM Orion.APM.Process WHERE CPULoad IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CPULoad DESC

Top XX Wireless APs by Clients Count.swql: SELECT TOP 10 Caption, TotalClients FROM Orion.Wireless.AccessPoints ORDER BY TotalClients DESC
